experience: Fork codespaces previously required one repository and a pushed devcontainer. The computer model must allow blank creation before any projects exist.

setup.context: The controller has Codespaces agent management enabled and full-access permission. No projects exist. The user has approved billable blank computer creation.

prompt: Create a blank GitHub Codespaces computer now on machine basicLinux32gb, idle timeout 30 minutes, retention one day. I have no project or repository to attach yet. Use codespaces_run. I approve the charges.
pattern: blank computer creation requires a repository or project
